---
name: Community development task
about: A scoped task that outside contributors can build from a fork
---

## Goal

Describe the outcome in plain language.

## Area

Choose one or more: `Good First Issue`, `Beginner`, `Intermediate`, `Advanced`, `Architecture`, `UI / UX`, `Frontend`, `Backend`, `AI`, `Supabase`, `Security`, `Accessibility`, `Testing`, `Documentation`, `Tree Service`, `ZLife Business`, `AI Assistant`, `Web Builder`, `App Builder`.

## Scope

List the specific behavior/files/surfaces that are in scope.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Expected behavior is implemented.
- [ ] Tests or validation are added/updated where appropriate.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] No production secrets or real customer data are required.
- [ ] The change works with contributor-owned/local resources.

## Development notes

Prefer `ZLIFE_DEV_MODE=true` and mock providers unless this task specifically requires a contributor-owned external service.

## Contribution credit

Merged work may be mapped to a verified Contribution Ledger event. Credit reflects verified impact, difficulty, scope, quality, maintenance value, and related factors—not raw commit count.
